notes.title: Launch of The Lovebirds
notes.content:
[h1][b]Finally![/b][/h1]

We've set The Lovebirds free for the world...
Now everyone's able to experience the story of James and Olivia!

Remember to report all the b̵̢̧̫̩̳̹̦̫͋̇͒͂͛͛̓̍͝u̷̮̮̪̝̼͕͛̓͒̊g̷̲̥͖̫̙̘͌͘͝s̵̳͓̺̳̈͠ ̸̲͋̓͗͗̾͗ḁ̶̠̣͕͖͐̊͒̃͌͆̽͝ͅn̵̢͖̦̳̺͗d̵̬̿̅́̈́̏̆͛̃̿ ̵̬̲͇̲͍̆͛g̸͙̼͓̹̟̩͍̩̤̊̑̌̇̅l̶͈̼̲̂͝i̶̜̲̖̞̭̅͐̍͊̑̕͠͝͝t̴͇͈̹͉̫͐͛̓̒̈́̚͘c̶͉̞̤̲͖͍͑̂͝h̷̡̝̼̯̹͖̭̩͗̉͊̽͒͘ȩ̷̜̥̉͜ş̶̗͊̌̋̈́̾̐̊ and give some feedback. Reviews are always helpful.

[b]An OST DLC[/b]

During the next few days, we'll be publishing the Soundtrack, containing all the 36 songs from The Lovebirds Act1 and the upcoming Act2. It will be on sale for the first few days so be fast!

Thank you so much everyone! <3
